paragraphs.en: Our research investigates how two adaptive AI methods, evolutionary transfer learning and TD( λ \lambda ), perform in the three-dimensional chess environment Dragonchess. The game challenges players with its unique board structure and computational load, making it an ideal setting to study how adaptive methods can update evaluation heuristics in novel environments. In this work we re-implement the Dragonchess engine, changing it from a PyGame engine to C++. This enables faster gameplay, allowing us to run 10,000 games with confidence intervals and significance tests, rather than a single small tournament. Both adaptive methods outperform all other agents in the round-robin tournament. Our results showed that there is no significant difference in the performance between the evolved and learned evaluations. This research establishes the efficacy of adaptive methods in structurally complex, novel game domains.

paragraphs.en: Game playing has demonstrated to be a productive testing ground for developments in the domain of artificial intelligence (AI). From early heuristic-based strategies in chess and checkers [ 3 ] to modern deep reinforcement learning approaches exemplified by systems like AlphaZero [ 14 ] , the field has progressed substantially in tailoring AI to intricate strategic settings. However, much of the previous research focused on games with moderately static board structures, primarily two-dimensional layouts with well-defined, stable piece-movement rules [ 6 ] . As AI strategies continue to advance, there is an ability to extend these techniques to increasingly complex game environments that present novel structural and strategic challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏已被证明是人工智能（AI）领域发展的一个富有成效的测试平台。 从早期基于启发式的国际象棋和跳棋策略 [ 3 ]，到以 AlphaZero 系统为代表的现代深度强化学习方法 [ 14 ]，该领域在将 AI 应用于复杂的战略场景中取得了显著进展。 然而，以往的大部分研究都集中在棋盘结构相对静态的游戏上，主要是具有明确且稳定的棋子移动规则的二维布局 [ 6 ]。 随着 AI 策略的持续进步，这些技术已能够扩展到结构更复杂、带来全新战略挑战的游戏环境中。

paragraphs.en: Dragonchess, a game developed by Gary Gygax, offers an interesting case for studying AI adaptation in novel game environments. In contrast to traditional chess, Dragonchess features a three-tiered board, substantially increasing the state and action space of the game [ 7 ] . Its unique framework offers multilevel interactions, distinct movement rules for different piece types, and challenges players to be more forward-thinking than conventional chess-like games. These factors make Dragonchess an immensely challenging domain for game-playing research, as more traditional search-based strategies and heuristic evaluations struggle with the domain’s increased complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 龙棋（Dragonchess）是由加里·吉加克斯（Gary Gygax）开发的一款游戏，为研究人工智能在新型游戏环境中的适应能力提供了一个有趣的案例。 与传统国际象棋不同，龙棋采用三层棋盘，从而显著扩大了游戏的状态空间和行动空间 [ 7 ] 。 其独特的框架支持多层级互动，为不同类型的棋子设定了不同的移动规则，并挑战玩家比传统国际象棋类游戏更具前瞻性思维。 这些因素使龙棋成为游戏研究领域中极具挑战性的课题，因为传统的基于搜索的策略和启发式评估方法难以应对该领域日益增长的复杂性。

paragraphs.en: Our previous work investigated evolutionary transfer learning in the context of Dragonchess by adapting heuristics from Stockfish, the leading open-source chess engine [ 11 ] . While these heuristics are optimized for conventional chess, they perform poorly when directly applied to Dragonchess, prompting us to employ the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) [ 9 ] to evolve them. This work showed that through the application of CMA-ES, transferred Stockfish heuristics can adapt to a competitive Dragonchess evaluation function, resulting in an agent that outperformed handcrafted Jackman and Gygax weightings in a Swiss tournament [ 10 ] . This motivated us to explore how a learning-based method would compare to the evolutionary agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们之前的工作研究了 Dragonchess 中的演化迁移学习，通过借鉴顶尖开源国际象棋引擎 Stockfish 的启发式规则来实现 [ 11 ]。 尽管这些启发式规则针对传统国际象棋进行了优化，但直接应用于 Dragonchess 时效果不佳，因此我们采用了协方差矩阵演化策略（CMA-ES）[ 9 ] 来对其进行演化。 这项工作表明，通过应用 CMA-ES，迁移而来的 Stockfish 启发式规则能够适应具有竞争力的 Dragonchess 评估函数，从而产生一个在瑞士制锦标赛中表现优于人工设计的 Jackman 和 Gygax 权重方案的智能体 [ 10 ]。 这促使我们进一步探索基于学习的方法与这种演化智能体相比会有怎样的表现。

paragraphs.en: In this extension, we create an agent that incorporates a temporal-difference self-play TD( λ \lambda ). TD( λ \lambda ) enables the agent to improve its evaluation function without external supervision or search labels [ 17 ] . Transfer learning and TD( λ \lambda ) differ significantly. The CMA-ES evolved agent scales a fixed set of transferred heuristics using a 14 14 -dimensional piece-value vector. In contrast, the learning-based agent fits a 40 40 -feature linear evaluation directly from self-play. It combines per-piece material terms with Dragonchess-specific positional signals such as frozen-piece counts, pieces stationed above certain enemies, and king-proximity counts. To compare these agents, we re-engineered the Dragonchess platform, replacing the original PyGame engine with an open-source C++ engine. It includes alpha-beta search and a transposition table, is more efficient, running thousands of decisive games per matchup, and reports statistical confidence intervals rather than a single tournament ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 在此扩展中，我们创建了一个融合了时序差分自我对弈 TD(λ) 的智能体。 TD(λ) 使智能体无需外部监督或搜索标签即可改进其评估函数 [17]。 迁移学习与 TD(λ) 存在显著差异。 通过 CMA-ES 进化的智能体使用一个 14 维棋子价值向量来缩放一组固定的迁移启发式方法。 相比之下，基于学习的智能体则直接从自我对弈中拟合一个包含 40 个特征的线性评估函数。 它将每个棋子的材料项与龙象国际象棋特有的位置信号相结合，例如冻结棋子数量、位于特定敌方棋子上方的棋子以及国王邻近度计数。 为了比较这些智能体，我们对龙象国际象棋平台进行了重新设计，将原有的 PyGame 引擎替换为开源的 C++ 引擎。 该引擎包含 α-β 搜索和转置表，效率更高，每场对局可运行数千盘决胜游戏，并报告统计置信区间而非单一的锦标赛排名。

paragraphs.en: Research on artificial intelligence in game-playing contexts has primarily focused on deterministic, fully observable domains such as chess, Go, and shogi. In these settings, deep search methods and heuristic evaluation functions have driven progress in computational play. Early chess engines, including Deep Blue [ 2 ] , illustrated the effectiveness of brute-force search when combined with refined heuristics. Subsequent approaches, such as Monte-Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), introduced simulation-based search, which proved extremely effective in games like Go [ 4 ] . Recent advances in deep reinforcement learning have emphasized self-play and learned policy networks, as illustrated by AlphaZero [ 14 ] and MuZero [ 12 ] . Although these methods have achieved notable success, they require substantial training time and computational resources, limiting their practicality for various emerging domains, like games with complex three-dimensional structures such as Dragonchess [ 15 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在游戏场景中的人工智能研究主要聚焦于确定性且完全可观测的领域，例如国际象棋、围棋和日本将棋。 在这些环境中，深度搜索方法和启发式评估函数推动了计算驱动型游戏水平的进步。 早期的国际象棋引擎（包括 Deep Blue [ 2 ]）展示了暴力搜索与优化启发式方法结合的有效性。 后续的方法，例如蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），引入了基于模拟的搜索策略，并证明其在围棋等游戏中极为有效 [ 4 ]。 近期深度强化学习的进展强调了自我对弈和策略网络的学习，AlphaZero [ 14 ] 和 MuZero [ 12 ] 便是典型案例。 尽管这些方法取得了显著成功，但它们需要大量的训练时间和计算资源，因此难以应用于各种新兴领域，例如具有复杂三维结构的龙象国际象棋 [ 15 ]。

paragraphs.en: Temporal Difference learning was formally introduced by Sutton as a method of using past experiences in an unknown environment to predict future outcomes in multi-step prediction problems [ 16 ] . Building on this primary work, research expanded into a wide range of fields. This includes game playing, in which agents learn effective policies through self-play [ 1 ] . Temporal-difference learning has also been used in finance to solve optimal execution problems [ 8 ] . Another strategy is TD( λ \lambda ), enabling temporal-difference methods to solve more complex problems. TD( λ \lambda ) has a computational cost similar to traditional TD methods but learns at a faster rate [ 17 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Sutton 正式提出了时序差分学习，这是一种利用未知环境中过往经验来预测多步预测问题中未来结果的方法 [ 16 ] 。 基于这项基础工作，相关研究扩展到了广泛领域。 这包括游戏领域，其中智能体通过自我对弈学习有效的策略 [ 1 ] 。 时序差分学习也被应用于金融领域，以解决最优执行问题 [ 8 ] 。 另一种策略是 TD( λ \lambda )，它使时序差分方法能够解决更复杂的问题。 TD( λ \lambda ) 的计算成本与传统时序差分方法相似，但学习速度更快 [ 17 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Dragonchess, originally created in 1985 by Gary Gygax in Dragon magazine, is a three-dimensional chess variant that introduces additional strategic complexity beyond traditional chess [ 7 ] . The game consists of three vertically stacked 12×8 boards, each portraying various terrain types: the top board represents the sky, the middle board symbolizes the land, and the bottom board corresponds to the underworld. Each board offers unique interactions and move restrictions, challenging players to think beyond the two-dimensional constraints of conventional chess.
paragraphs.zh: 龙棋最初由加里·吉加克斯于 1985 年在《龙》杂志上创作，是一种三维国际象棋变体，在传统国际象棋的基础上引入了额外的策略复杂性 [ 7 ] 。 该游戏由三个垂直堆叠的 12×8 棋盘组成，每个棋盘都描绘了不同的地形类型：最上方的棋盘代表天空，中间的棋盘象征陆地，而最下方的棋盘则对应地下世界。 每个棋盘都提供了独特的互动方式和移动限制，挑战玩家突破传统国际象棋的二维限制进行思考。

paragraphs.en: Dragonchess offers varied gameplay, introducing inter-board mobility and atypical movement patterns. For instance, the Basilisk, occupying the "Underworld" board, can briefly freeze opponents on the "Land" board, adding a unique strategic dimension. The Dragon, an extremely influential piece, remains on the top board but has the unparalleled ability to capture pieces on the middle board without moving. Other pieces, such as the Griffin and the Hero, can move vertically between boards. These complex interactions highlight the significance of vertical placement and inter-board strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 龙棋提供了多样化的玩法，引入了跨棋盘移动和非典型的移动模式。 例如，占据“地下世界”棋盘的巴适斯克，可以在“陆地”棋盘上短暂冻结对手，增添了独特的战略维度。 龙是一种极具影响力的棋子，它停留在最上方的棋盘上，却拥有无需移动即可捕获中间棋盘上棋子的无与伦比的能力。 其他棋子，如狮鹫和英雄，可以在棋盘之间垂直移动。 这些复杂的互动凸显了垂直位置安排和跨棋盘策略的重要性。

paragraphs.en: One of Dragonchess’ most challenging features is its considerably expanded state space. Standard chess offers roughly 10 43 10^{43} legal configurations [ 13 ] . Dragonchess’ three-tiered board structure dramatically increases this number to around 10 63 10^{63} . The game’s unique movement system introduces novel strategic decisions, such as restricting enemy movement by controlling vertical positions or organizing multi-board assaults. These elements of the game make heuristic evaluation challenging, as more traditional evaluation functions struggle to capture the intricate interplay between boards.
paragraphs.zh: Dragonchess最具挑战性的特征之一是其状态空间的大幅扩展。 标准国际象棋大约有 10^{43} 种合法布局 [13]。 Dragonchess的三层棋盘结构将这一数字大幅提升至约 10^{63}。 该游戏独特的移动系统引入了全新的战略决策，例如通过控制垂直位置来限制敌方移动，或组织跨棋盘的联合进攻。 这些游戏元素使得启发式评估变得困难，因为传统的评估函数难以捕捉各棋盘之间复杂的相互作用。

paragraphs.en: In Dragonchess, AI techniques such as traditional search struggle with the game’s immense action space, since interactions occur across three boards rather than on a 2D plane. Previously established chess heuristics, such as board control and piece mobility, do not directly translate to Dragonchess, as piece values vary significantly with board position and potential vertical mobility. Some pieces, like a Mage, are very mobile on the Land board but are limited on the Sky or Underworld boards, requiring heuristic adjustment to account for these transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 在龙棋中，传统搜索等人工智能技术难以应对该游戏巨大的行动空间，因为交互发生在三个棋盘上，而非二维平面上。 此前在象棋中确立的启发式方法，例如棋盘控制和棋子移动性，无法直接应用于龙棋，因为棋子价值会因棋盘位置和潜在的垂直移动能力而显著变化。 某些棋子（如法师）在陆地棋盘上具有极高的移动性，但在天空或地下棋盘上则受到限制，因此需要调整启发式方法以应对这些转换。

paragraphs.en: These complex systems make Dragonchess a productive testbed for evaluating heuristic adaptation and evolutionary optimization techniques. The difficulties traditional chess heuristics encounter in Dragonchess suggest investigating adaptive optimization methods so the weight of these metrics can be adapted to a multi-board environment. Understanding these challenges aids in creating stronger Dragonchess-playing AI and offers broader insights into the adaptability of heuristic-based AI in novel strategic environments.
paragraphs.zh: 这些复杂系统使龙棋成为评估启发式适应和进化优化技术的理想试验平台。 传统国际象棋启发式方法在龙棋中遇到的困难表明，有必要研究自适应优化方法，以便根据多棋盘环境调整这些指标的重要性权重。 理解这些挑战有助于开发更强大的龙棋人工智能，并为启发式人工智能在新战略环境中的适应能力提供更广泛的见解。

paragraphs.en: Our previous work demonstrated that CMA-ES [ 9 ] can be used to adapt transferred Stockfish heuristics into an evaluation function for the Dragonchess chess variant. paragraphs.en: We also introduce a re-engineered experimental platform, replacing the original PyGame engine [ 10 ] with an open-source C++ engine. paragraphs.en: The study done in this work was enabled by our re-implementation of the Dragonchess game engine into C++. paragraphs.en: The new C++ engine uses alpha-beta search with a transposition table and a typed move generator. With the depth-2 setting used in this study, it plays a complete self-play game (averaging several hundred plies) in approximately 85 ms. The engine sustains around 12 games per second on 16 threads for the draw-heavy, strong agent matches, and even faster for more decisive ones. The full 10,000-game round-robin finishes in about six minutes on a single workstation, making the confidence intervals and significance tests affordable. Previously, our PyGame engine could report one ranking, whereas the same hardware budget here yields hundreds of decisive games per pairing. The engine is open-source, released alongside the original Python implementation 1 1 1 https://github.com/joconno2/DragonchessAI-Engine . Figure 2 shows the GUI of our game engine.
paragraphs.zh: 这款新的 C++ 引擎采用了结合置换表和类型化走法生成器的阿尔法-贝塔搜索算法。 在本研究中使用的深度为 2 的设置下，它完成一局完整的自我对弈（平均数百个步数）大约需要 85 毫秒。 在与擅长和棋的强智能体对局中，该引擎可在 16 个线程上每秒维持约 12 局的对弈速度，而在胜负更明确的对局中速度甚至更快。 完整的 10,000 局循环赛在一台工作站上大约六分钟即可结束，这使得置信区间和显著性检验的计算成本变得可控。 此前，我们的 PyGame 引擎只能报告一个排名，而这里在相同硬件预算下，每对组合却能产生数百局胜负明确的对局。 该引擎是开源的，并与原始的 Python 实现一同发布 1 1 1 https://github.com/joconno2/DragonchessAI-Engine 。 图 2 展示了我们游戏引擎的用户界面。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 and Figure 3 show the final standings of each of our five agents; Table 2 details the head-to-head matches. Two findings stand out: our adaptive evaluation methods (bolded in Table 1 ) were the strongest performers, and the evolved and learned evaluators are indistinguishable when going head-to-head, statistically speaking.

sents.zh: 有两个发现尤为突出：我们的自适应评估方法（在表 1 中以粗体标出）表现最强，而从统计角度来看，经过进化和学习的评估者在直接对决中无法区分。

paragraphs.en: Both adaptive methods clearly outperform both the handcrafted baseline and plain search, as demonstrated in Table 1 . The evolved evaluator beats Jackman on 0.743 0.743 of decisive games ( p < 10 − 32 p<10^{-32} ) and alpha-beta on 0.758 0.758 ( p < 10 − 39 p<10^{-39} ), while the learned evaluator beats Jackman on 0.601 0.601 ( p < 10 − 9 p<10^{-9} ) and alpha-beta on 0.560 0.560 ( p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} ). The handcrafted Jackman agent is statistically indistinguishable from simple depth-2 search ( 0.497 0.497 , p = 0.88 p=0.88 ), confirming that the gains we see in the adaptive methods are coming from adapted evaluation, not from search. This bolsters the claim from our previous work: gradient-free adaptation of a transferred evaluation outperforms handcrafted weights [ 10 ] . These results also demonstrate how this holds for a second, mechanistically different method.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 1 所示，两种自适应方法都明显优于人工设计的基线方法和普通搜索方法。 演化评估器在决定性对局中击败 Jackman 的比例为 0.743（p < 10^{-32}），击败 alpha-beta 的比例为 0.758（p < 10^{-39}）；而学习评估器击败 Jackman 的比例为 0.601（p < 10^{-9}），击败 alpha-beta 的比例为 0.560（p < 10^{-3}）。 人工设计的 Jackman 智能体在统计上与简单的深度为 2 的搜索方法无法区分（0.497，p = 0.88），这证实了我们在自适应方法中观察到的提升源于评估函数的适配，而非搜索过程。 这一结果支持了我们先前工作的结论：对迁移评估函数进行无梯度自适应，其效果优于人工设计的权重 [10]。 这些结果也表明，对于第二种机制不同的方法，这一结论同样成立。

paragraphs.en: The second finding we can see in Table 2 : the evolved and learned evaluators are not statistically different in head-to-head matches. Over 1000 games, TD( λ \lambda ) scores 0.503 0.503 of decisive games against CMA-ES (95% CI [ 0.463 , 0.544 ] [0.463,0.544] , n = 576 n{=}576 decisive). Further, the CMA-ES agent has the top overall Elo ( 1678 1678 vs. 1653 1653 ) by defeating the weaker baselines more decisively and with a higher draw rate, not by beating the learned agent. Therefore, a self-play learner with no search supervision reaches the same performance tier as the evolved evaluator which required a population-based outer loop.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在表2中观察到的第二个发现是：经过进化和学习的评估智能体在直接对抗中并无统计学上的显著差异。 在超过1000局游戏中，TD(λ) 在与CMA-ES的对决中获得了0.503的决胜局得分（95%置信区间 [0.463, 0.544]，n = 576局为决胜局）。 此外，CMA-ES智能体凭借更果断地击败较弱的基线模型以及更高的平局率，获得了最高的整体Elo评分（1678分 vs. 1653分），而非通过战胜学习智能体实现的。 因此，一个没有搜索监督的自我对弈学习者，其表现水平与需要基于种群的外层循环的进化评估智能体达到了同一层次。

paragraphs.en: The study completed in this paper highlights the generality of the work presented in [ 10 ] , demonstrating that adapting a transferred evaluation by either evolution or self-play learning, yields agents that are in the same strength tier and significantly above handcrafted weights. These results show that the learned evaluator matches (not surpasses) the evolved one at the tested search depth.

paragraphs.en: Our study has two limitations that leave room for future investigation. First, draw rates tend to be high among the strongest agents, up to ∼ 40 % \sim 40\% . This is a property of shallow and material-dominated play. Second, the learned and evolved agents utilize different feature parameterizations, 40 learned features vs. 14 evolved piece values. Therefore, the comparison is between methods with their natural representations, as opposed to a single representation optimized two ways. A representation-matched study, where the 40-feature vector is evolved with CMA-ES or warm-starting evolution from the learned weights, is a natural future direction.
